application_policy: Apply the background-plus-independent-elements collage method as defaults. User theme, story, assets, brand constraints, copy and compliance requirements override all default motifs.

timeline_model_30s.editing_logic: A clean background base receives one unexpected or important hero element.
timeline_model_30s.purpose: Set topic, mood and visual grammar without forcing generated title text.

timeline_model_30s.editing_logic: Introduce character, prop and scene-window in a deliberate order.
timeline_model_30s.purpose: Make the main concept or story relationship visible.
timeline_model_30s.duration_guidance: 1-3s placements; allow a short hold after each important relationship

timeline_model_30s.editing_logic: Use an assembly, swap, opening flap, zoomed window or small rapid collage cluster.
timeline_model_30s.purpose: Show mechanism, causality, joke, conflict or transformation.
timeline_model_30s.duration_guidance: two to four 0.6-1.2s transfers, then a 2s reading pause

timeline_model_30s.editing_logic: Return to a composed hero board or let the scene window become full frame.
timeline_model_30s.purpose: Leave one visual memory and a safe zone for post-produced closing text.

audio_design_model.principle: Synchronize sound with visible material and object behavior. The sound palette changes with the project world, while the timing remains tactile and readable.
audio_design_model.music_policy: Do not ask video models to generate per-clip background music; score and beat music are added in post-production.
audio_design_model.text_policy: No generated readable text or subtitles. Exact typography, labels, arrows, captions and citations are post-production packaging.
